record.title: Abkhaz COVID restrictions at Enguri
record.direction: Both directions except directional humanitarian permissions
record.movement: Ordinary residents travelling across the boundary
record.exceptions: Time-limited return corridors; pensioners, elderly people and medical or special-needs cases
record.enforcement: Contemporary chronology distinguishes 27 February restrictions from 14 March closure. Georgian SSG and EUMM confirm July easing.
record.context: Initial restrictions on 27 February expanded to ordinary closure on 14 March; temporary humanitarian corridors followed.
record.uncertainty: Not continuous total exclusion: humanitarian passages operated in 2020 and limited easing in February 2021. From 5 July permission-holders could cross; unrestricted travel was not established.

historical.duration_note: Not eligible for a single continuous-duration calculation; see movement scope, phases and uncertainty
